$comment: THE WARDROBE MANIFEST (build 25): the single source of truth for every piece of Bolo clothing. `node scripts/wardrobe.mjs codegen` regenerates the server catalogue table, mobile's literal require() maps and both clients' shop racks from this file; `gen`/`install` drive the compositing generators with each item's recorded recipe. Hand-edit THIS file, never the generated ones. BUILD 29 ADDED ONE OWNER RULING AND NAMED ONE BUG. (1) FLAT GARMENTS ARE RETIRED. Nineteen were generated and none ever shipped, because the wing restack, the sleeve rule and the silhouette clip together reduce every saree, kurta and sherwani to a bib; four recuts of one sherwani proved no tuning fixes it. Stock headwear and held props only. Garments return via the 3D mascot, not via more flat art. The sources stay on disk under unshippedSources, unstocked. (2) THE OPEN BUG IS crownCenterX IN gen-mascot-accessories.mjs, which thresholds ALPHA and takes the largest component, so a raised wing can win the crown band on a rolled pose. Its own comment names the fix (isolate the head by COLOUR, not by size) and the discriminator is the GREEN channel: her head is teal (green ~160) and her wings and crest are indigo (green ~48). The band also has to be found in her HEAD frame, because on tryagain the current band sits above her teal crown entirely and a colour test there returns nothing. The laws that bound every entry: the canonical mascot rule (she is never redrawn), the sleeve rule (wings redraw in front of cloth, so sleeved outerwear can never work; a Western jacket set was generated once and rejected - do not regenerate it), and eye clearance for anything on her head. costBand maps to server tokenEconomy constants: standard=OUTFIT_COST, premium=PREMIUM_OUTFIT_COST, accessory=ACCESSORY_COST.

A placed pose wins outright, so crown seating, the clearance lift and the old nudge overrides are all bypassed here.
